description: Every client NAS's Active Backup jobs and storage health, mirrored into one local SQLite database and checked with one command.

env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_ACCOUNT
env_var_specs.description: DSM account name used for the SYNO.API.Auth login

env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD
env_var_specs.description: DSM account password; sent in the login request body, never stored by the CLI

env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID
env_var_specs.description: Trusted-device token (did) from a previous two-factor login, used instead of a one-time code

env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_OTP_CODE
env_var_specs.description: Six-digit one-time code for the first login of a two-factor account

tools.name: abb_backup
tools.description: Start a backup now for one or more tasks. Required: task_ids.

params.name: task_ids
params.description: JSON array of task ids, for example [5] or [5,8]

tools.name: abb_cancel
tools.description: Cancel the running backup of one or more tasks. Required: task_ids.

params.name: task_ids
params.description: JSON array of task ids, for example [5]

tools.name: abb_hypervisors
tools.description: List the VMware and Hyper-V hypervisors registered in Active Backup for Business.

tools.name: abb_logs
tools.description: Read the Active Backup for Business activity log for the package, tasks and devices. Optional: task_id, filter, offset (plus 1 more).

params.name: task_id
params.description: Only log lines of this task

params.name: filter
params.description: JSON filter, for example {'log_level':0} for errors only or {'key_word':'timeout'}

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first log line to return

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of log lines to return

tools.name: abb_result_detail
tools.description: Show the detail log lines (errors, warnings, skipped paths) of one job result. Required: result_id. Optional: limit (default: 500), order_by, direction.

params.name: result_id
params.description: Job result id from abb results or abb tasks (last_result.result_id)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of detail lines to return

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field, log_level or log_time

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction

tools.name: abb_results
tools.description: List job results across tasks (backups plus version deletions and restores; filter {'job_action':1} for backups only) with status, times and error counts. Optional: task_id, filter, offset (plus 1 more).

params.name: task_id
params.description: Only results of this task

params.name: filter
params.description: JSON filter, for example {'status':4} for failed runs or {'from_timestamp':1741900000}. status 2 success, 3 partial, 4 failed, 5 canceled, 6 no backup; job_action 1 backup

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first result to return

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: abb_settings
tools.description: Show Active Backup for Business package settings and certificate information.

tools.name: abb_storage
tools.description: List Active Backup for Business storage destinations with dedup size, device counts and volume.

tools.name: abb_tasks
tools.description: List Active Backup for Business tasks with their last job result, protected devices, progress and next run time. Optional: load_versions, filter.

params.name: load_versions
params.description: Include each task's backup versions (restore points)

params.name: filter
params.description: JSON filter object, for example {'task_id':5} or {'backup_type':2}. backup_type 1 vm, 2 pc, 3 physical server, 4 file server, 5 nas

tools.name: abb_transfers
tools.description: List protected devices with every transfer (bytes, status, start, end) inside a time window. Required: time_start, time_end.

params.name: time_start
params.description: Window start, epoch seconds

params.name: time_end
params.description: Window end, epoch seconds

tools.name: folder_list
tools.description: List shared folders, including the ActiveBackupforBusiness destination share. Optional: additional.

params.name: additional
params.description: JSON array of extra fields, for example ['encryption','share_quota']

tools.name: group_list
tools.description: List local DSM groups on the NAS, for example to find the administrators group. Optional: offset, limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first group

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of groups

tools.name: group_members
tools.description: List the accounts in one group, for example administrators. Required: group.

params.name: group
params.description: Group name

tools.name: hyperbackup_task_status
tools.description: Show one Hyper Backup task's last result, last success, next run and health state without contacting the destination. Required: task_id.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Hyper Backup task id from hyperbackup tasks

tools.name: hyperbackup_tasks
tools.description: List Hyper Backup tasks (the NAS's own backups to another NAS, USB or cloud) with their destination type.

tools.name: log_list
tools.description: Read the DSM system log with level, date range and keyword filters. Optional: logtype, level, keyword (plus 4 more).

params.name: logtype
params.description: Log category, for example system or connection

params.name: level
params.description: Minimum severity, for example err, warn or info

params.name: keyword
params.description: Substring the message must contain

params.name: date_from
params.description: Earliest entry, epoch seconds

params.name: date_to
params.description: Latest entry, epoch seconds

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first entry

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entries

tools.name: package_list
tools.description: List installed packages with version and running state; confirms Active Backup for Business is installed. Optional: additional.

params.name: additional
params.description: JSON array of extra fields, for example ['status','version']

tools.name: session_apis
tools.description: List every API namespace this NAS exposes with its version range and CGI path; shows whether Active Backup for Business is installed. (public)

tools.name: session_logout
tools.description: Invalidate the current DSM session id so it can no longer be used on this NAS.

tools.name: storage_disks
tools.description: List physical disks with model, serial number, temperature and SMART health status.

tools.name: storage_overview
tools.description: Show Storage Manager's disks, storage pools and volumes with their status in one call.

tools.name: storage_pools
tools.description: List storage pools with RAID type, status and member disks.

tools.name: storage_smart
tools.description: Show the SMART attribute table for one disk. Required: device.

params.name: device
params.description: Disk device path as reported by storage disks, for example /dev/sata1 or /dev/sda

tools.name: storage_smart_schedule
tools.description: List the scheduled SMART tests (quick or extended) configured for the NAS's disks.

tools.name: storage_volumes
tools.description: List volumes with status, size, used space and file system.

tools.name: system_dsm
tools.description: Show DSM product identity (model, version string, serial) as the web UI reports it.

tools.name: system_get
tools.description: Show model, serial number, DSM version, uptime and system temperature. Optional: type.

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict the report to one section, for example storage

tools.name: system_health_check
tools.description: Show the aggregate system health verdict the DSM dashboard shows.

tools.name: system_network
tools.description: Show the NAS hostname, DNS servers, default gateway and network interface settings.

tools.name: system_ups
tools.description: Show the state of the uninterruptible power supply (UPS) attached to the NAS, if any.

tools.name: system_utilization
tools.description: Show current CPU, memory, disk and network utilization.

tools.name: user_list
tools.description: List local user accounts, for example to audit who can log in to a client NAS. Optional: type, additional, offset (plus 1 more).

params.name: type
params.description: Account source, for example local

params.name: additional
params.description: JSON array of extra fields, for example ['email','expired','description']

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first account

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of accounts

novel_features.name: Fleet status rollup
novel_features.description: One row per client NAS with backup outcomes, stale devices, worst storage state and sync age; exits 6 when any NAS is warning, critical or unknown (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: ABB failures
novel_features.description: Every Active Backup task across the fleet whose latest run in a window failed, partially succeeded, was canceled, or never ran.

novel_features.name: Stale protection
novel_features.description: Protected PCs, servers and VMs whose last successful backup is older than a threshold, or that never succeeded.

novel_features.name: Per-NAS fleet sync
novel_features.description: Mirror ABB job status and storage health from every NAS registered with fleet add into one local database, each NAS with its own login.

novel_features.name: Fleet storage health
novel_features.description: Degraded or crashed volumes and pools, disks with bad SMART status, hot disks and nearly full volumes across every NAS, with days-to-full when history exists.

novel_features.name: Failed-task triage
novel_features.description: Why one ABB task failed: its newest non-success run, its detail lines and the ABB log from that window, errors first. Live call to one NAS; DSM returns log types and parameters, not message text.

novel_features.name: Device lookup
novel_features.description: Find a machine by host name across every NAS and see which task protects it, its last success and its recent runs.

novel_features.name: Backup trend
novel_features.description: Per task or device: run count, success rate, median and p90 duration, and an overrun flag when the latest run is far slower than usual.

novel_features.name: Protection dropped
novel_features.description: Devices and tasks that dropped out of Active Backup protection across the fleet: a machine removed from its task, a task deleted, or a task whose schedule is off while it still holds devices; exits 6 when any exist or a NAS mirror is not synced or ABB stopped answering (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: Volume runway
novel_features.description: Every volume on every NAS with used percent, growth per day and days until full from retained storage snapshots, soonest first; exits 6 when a volume fills inside the horizon (default 30 days), a volume's capacity is unknown, or a NAS's storage cannot be read (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: Change-rate anomaly
novel_features.description: Devices whose newest good backup moved far more data than their own median (a mass file change) or nothing at all for several runs in a row, across the fleet; exits 6 when any device is flagged or a NAS mirror is not synced or ABB stopped answering (--no-fail exits 0).
